title: Reading: Asking for directions
goal: Ask the way and understand the answer.
goal_it: Chiedere la strada e capire la risposta.

steps.title: Key phrases
en: Learn the language for asking and giving directions.
it: Impara le frasi per chiedere e dare indicazioni.

head: English
Italiano
rows: Excuse me, how do I get to the station?
Turn left at the traffic lights.
Take the second street on the right.
Prenda la seconda strada a destra.

steps.title: On the street
en: A tourist asks a local for help. Read the conversation.
Tourist: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the train station?
Local: Of course. Go straight on for two hundred metres.
Tourist: Is it far from here?
Local: No, it's about five minutes on foot.
Local: At the traffic lights, turn left. Then take the second street on the right.
Tourist: Left at the lights, then second on the right. Got it.
Local: The station is opposite the post office. You can't miss it.
Local: You're welcome. Have a nice day.
it: Un turista chiede aiuto a una persona del posto. Leggi la conversazione.
Turista: Scusi, può dirmi come arrivare alla stazione?
Persona del posto: Certo. Vada dritto per duecento metri.
Persona del posto: No, sono circa cinque minuti a piedi.
Persona del posto: Al semaforo giri a sinistra. Poi prenda la seconda strada a destra.
Turista: Sinistra al semaforo, poi la seconda a destra. Capito.
Persona del posto: La stazione è di fronte all'ufficio postale. Non può sbagliare.
Persona del posto: Prego. Buona giornata.

steps.q: How long does it take to walk to the station?
steps.q_it: Quanto ci vuole a piedi fino alla stazione?
steps.why: The local says: about five minutes on foot.
steps.why_it: La persona dice: about five minutes on foot.

steps.q: What must the tourist do at the traffic lights?
steps.q_it: Cosa deve fare il turista al semaforo?
steps.why: The local says: At the traffic lights, turn left.
steps.why_it: La persona dice: At the traffic lights, turn left.

options: On the corner of a park
steps.why: The local says it is opposite the post office.
steps.why_it: La persona dice che è di fronte all'ufficio postale.

steps.q: Excuse me, how do I ___ to the station?
Go ___ on for two hundred metres.
steps.why: Go straight on means keep going forward.
steps.why_it: Go straight on significa continuare dritto.

steps.q: At the traffic lights, turn ___. It is the opposite of right.
steps.q_it: Al semaforo giri a sinistra. È il contrario di right.
steps.why: Left is the opposite of right.
steps.why_it: Left è il contrario di right.

answers: The station is opposite the post office
